Studied: Psychology.description:
💭 You studied the mind: psychology courses, a peer counseling program or volunteer shifts on a support line.

🌱 Stress and trauma responses, motivation, group behavior and basic counseling. You recognize panic, shock and grief and respond in ways that help.
⚠️ Deep trauma, serious mental illness and skilled manipulators are beyond you.
⚖️ You are not a counselor or clinician: you cannot diagnose or treat, and you refer people to professionals.
🏫 It shows in patient questions, careful wording and a habit of noticing who has gone quiet.

📈 Grants: Psychology +15
